description: P3.A follow-up: high-precision (50 dps) verification of the C1 = log(1/t) lead at t = h(q_0) for Δ_coupling at the doubly-magic (2,2) anchor and the (2,1) / (1,2) free-nucleon-clustering anchors. Tests the leading-factor ladder {(A−2), Z+N, Z·N, Z²+N², (A−2)², min(Z,N), Z·N−1}, a candidate (Z−N) chirality residual, and a q-dilogarithm alternative. Diagnostic probe — does NOT fit Δ_coupling to AME (forbidden by three-cal discipline).

H2_chirality_residual_test_DEFERRED.reason: Requires Δ_cat values for proton and neutron, which are added by PR #644 (per_atom_delta_cat['proton'] / ['neutron']) but not yet on main. Re-run this script post-#644 merge to populate H2.
H2_chirality_residual_test_DEFERRED.expected_test: If residual = c · (Z−N), then res(2,1) + res(1,2) = 0. The float64 prior run in PR #644 reports res(2,1) + res(1,2) = −0.257 MeV, which falsifies the pure (Z−N) chirality ansatz.

H4_q_dilogarithm_at_t_h.verdict: No clean integer factor: ratios are (2,2)_doubly_magic=-1.73774

H5_t_eq_q_minus_1.verdict: No clean integer factor at t = q_0 − 1; values are (2,2)_doubly_magic=1.42817

summary.leading_form_candidate: Δ_coupling(2,2) ≈ 2 · E_0 · log(1/h(q_0))   at t = h(q_0)
summary.structural_finding: At the doubly-magic (2,2) anchor and 50 dps precision, Δ_coupling(2,2) = 2 · E_0 · log(1/h(q_0)) holds with relative gap +0.71% (~7100 ppm). This is well above the 1 ppb target, so the ansatz is a leading-order STRUCTURAL near-form, not a 1 ppb closure. The next steps are: (a) re-run this probe post-#644 merge to add the (2,1) and (1,2) anchors and confirm whether (A−2) generalises, (b) test higher-order categorical corrections (q-dilog or KLR canonical-basis dim count) to close the 7100 ppm residual, (c) derive the (A−2) prefactor from substrate primitives (Markov-trace / KLR structure) before any Lean §3b-cond Pattern-A/B promotion.

caveats: DIAGNOSTIC PROBE ONLY — does not fit Δ_coupling to AME. The (A−2)·E_0·log(1/h(q_0)) form is suggested by the data but would need to be derived from substrate primitives (KLR / Markov-trace structure) for inclusion in the §3b-cond canonical instance MagicShellCrossCoupling.canonicalCrossCoupling. A numerical near-fit is NOT acceptable as a Pattern-A/B Lean instance per CLAUDE.md §3b-cond + the trivial-skeleton workplan.

The 0.71% gap at the (2,2) doubly-magic anchor exceeds the 780 ppb hard floor by ~10000× — closing it requires either a structurally-derived correction term OR demonstrating that the residual lies within the topology-class assumption error of the magic-shell ansatz itself.

(Z−N) chirality residual hypothesis (H2) is DEFERRED — needs Δ_cat for proton and neutron from PR #644's magic-shell-empirical-instantiation witness extension. The float64 prior run in PR #644 reports res(2,1) + res(1,2) = −0.257 MeV which would FALSIFY a pure (Z−N) ansatz; this probe should be re-run at 50 dps post-#644 merge to confirm.
